Prompt: A Hatch talk about adapting product decisions to local workflows and reading beyond feedback labels or blended metrics.
Read the raw feedback for one decision, compare relevant groups on compatible measures, and record what would change the recommendation.
Who will do the work, review it and maintain the outcome?
What decision affects which user task? Separate evidence from a competitor feature or stakeholder request.
Which workflow, market, language or trust conditions could change the answer? Link evidence and gaps.
What do the actual comments say? Does the survey label describe the problem accurately?
Record relevant cohorts, definitions, time windows, denominators and sample sizes before comparing.
What should stay, change or be tested? State what evidence would change this recommendation.
Choose a bounded action and the observation or delivery check it needs.
Which claims remain uncertain? Avoid inferring national traits or a cause from pooled results.
What is agreed, what remains open, who owns it and when will it be reviewed?
